detailed_description:
The target video is a photoreal blockbuster CGI film shot on anamorphic lenses with volumetric haze and high dynamic range: golden sunrise light, horizontal lens flares and gold reflections against cool blue shadows, with teal thruster accents. Keep the main action in the vertical center with about 12% clear space top and bottom; no on-screen text or logos.
[Shot 1] Wide shot, very low angle from behind <Subject 1>, small in the foreground left of center, slow tilt up, the sea at frame right. Initial state: <Subject 2> sits parked beside her. Its panels unlock; the cab folds back, the tires rotate onto the shoulders and lower legs, massive legs unfold onto the stone, and the torso rises on pumping pistons. The head lifts last and the amber optic band ignites. End state: <Subject 3> stands twelve meters tall, a lamppost at its ankle for scale, as <Subject 1> tilts her head back to look up.
